metadata.question: Was the soil in Washington more moist on November 22, 2021 than November 15, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need soil moisture data for Washington state (USA) - Two specific dates: November 22, 2021 and November 15, 2021 - Best dataset: NASA-USDA SMAP Global Soil Moisture Data (10km resolution) - Collection: "NASA_USDA/HSL/SMAP10KM_soil_moisture" - Bands: 'ssm' (surface soil moisture) or 'susm' (subsurface soil moisture) 2. Masking strategy: - SMAP data has quality flags - should use only valid pixels - No cloud masking needed (microwave satellite data, all-weather) - Check for valid data availability on both dates 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Soil moisture can be legitimately low (near 0) in dry conditions - C1: If no images found for either date - C2: If images exist but all pixels are masked/invalid - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN or values outside valid range (soil moisture should be 0-1 or 0-100%) - A: If Nov 22 > Nov 15 (more moist) - B: If Nov 22 <= Nov 15 (not more moist) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions washington = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-124.7, 49.0], [-124.7, 45.5], [-116.9, 45.5], [-116.9, 49.0], [-124.7, 49.0]] ]) date1 = '2021-11-15' date2 = '2021-11-22' # 2. Data Acquisition & Check smap = ee.ImageCollection('NASA_USDA/HSL/SMAP10KM_soil_moisture') col1 = smap.filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')).filterBounds(washington) col2 = smap.filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')).filterBounds(washington) size1 = col1.size().getInfo() size2 = col2.size().getInfo() print(f"Nov 15 Images: {size1}") print(f"Nov 22 Images: {size2}") if size1 == 0 or size2 == 0: print("Missing data for one or both dates.") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - get first (only) image from each collection img1 = col1.first().select('ssm') img2 = col2.first().select('ssm') # Check pixel counts count1 = img1.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=washington, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('ssm').getInfo() count2 = img2.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=washington, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('ssm').getInfo() print(f"Nov 15 Valid Pixels: {count1}") print(f"Nov 22 Valid Pixels: {count2}") if count1 == 0 or count2 == 0: print("No valid pixels after processing.") print("C2") else: # 4. Calculation - mean soil moisture sm1 = img1.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=washington, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('ssm').getInfo() sm2 = img2.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=washington, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('ssm').getInfo() # 5. Validation & Final Answer print(f"Nov 15 Mean SSM: {sm1}") print(f"Nov 22 Mean SSM: {sm2}") if sm1 is None or sm2 is None: print("Calculation returned None.") print("C3") elif sm1 < 0 or sm2 < 0 or sm1 > 100 or sm2 > 100: print("Invalid soil moisture values (out of range).") print("C3") elif sm2 > sm1: print(f"Nov 22 ({sm2:.2f}) > Nov 15 ({sm1:.2f}) - More moist") print("A") else: print(f"Nov 22 ({sm2:.2f}) <= Nov 15 ({sm1:.2f}) - Not more moist") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
washington = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[-124.7, 49.0], [-124.7, 45.5], [-116.9, 45.5], [-116.9, 49.0], [-124.7, 49.0]]
])

date1 = '2021-11-15'
date2 = '2021-11-22'

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
smap = ee.ImageCollection('NASA_USDA/HSL/SMAP10KM_soil_moisture')

col1 = smap.filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')).filterBounds(washington)
col2 = smap.filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')).filterBounds(washington)

size1 = col1.size().getInfo()
size2 = col2.size().getInfo()

print(f"Nov 15 Images: {size1}")
print(f"Nov 22 Images: {size2}")

if size1 == 0 or size2 == 0:
    print("Missing data for one or both dates.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - get first (only) image from each collection
    img1 = col1.first().select('ssm')
    img2 = col2.first().select('ssm')
    
    # Check pixel counts
    count1 = img1.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=washington,
        scale=10000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('ssm').getInfo()
    
    count2 = img2.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=washington,
        scale=10000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('ssm').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Nov 15 Valid Pixels: {count1}")
    print(f"Nov 22 Valid Pixels: {count2}")
    
    if count1 == 0 or count2 == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after processing.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # 4. Calculation - mean soil moisture
        sm1 = img1.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=washington,
            scale=10000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('ssm').getInfo()
        
        sm2 = img2.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=washington,
            scale=10000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('ssm').getInfo()
        
        # 5. Validation & Final Answer
        print(f"Nov 15 Mean SSM: {sm1}")
        print(f"Nov 22 Mean SSM: {sm2}")
        
        if sm1 is None or sm2 is None:
            print("Calculation returned None.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif sm1 < 0 or sm2 < 0 or sm1 > 100 or sm2 > 100:
            print("Invalid soil moisture values (out of range).")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif sm2 > sm1:
            print(f"Nov 22 ({sm2:.2f}) > Nov 15 ({sm1:.2f}) - More moist")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print(f"Nov 22 ({sm2:.2f}) <= Nov 15 ({sm1:.2f}) - Not more moist")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
